verdict.rationale: Box docs mention embeddable, expiring file previews with in-context annotation (box-docs-14), which supports the core story of API-driven previews without client-side rendering. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated thumbnail-generation endpoint, supported format list, or preview API reference details, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of preview rendering fidelity. missing for 10: explicit thumbnail API endpoint docs, list of supported formats, independent verification of preview quality/reliability.
